ATLAR.name: AC Hotel Atlanta Downtown
ATLAR.description: Recharge at AC Hotels Atlanta Downtown, where modern design meets European-inspired simplicity in the heart of Downtown Atlanta, GA. Located near Mercedes-Benz Stadium, our hotel is perfectly placed near Centennial Olympic Park, Georgia World Congress Center, and Georgia Aquarium. Relax in spacious rooms with hardwood floors, rainfall showerheads, well-lit workstations, and curated amenities. Start your morning at AC Kitchen, then unwind with cocktails and tapas at AC Lounge. Explore the vibrant dining scene at Centennial Yards. Take a dip in the outdoor pool or stay on track in our expansive fitness center with zen garden views. On-site parking is available, and with walkable access to State Farm Arena, Tabernacle, and COSM Atlanta, this is one of the nicest hotels in Downtown Atlanta. Earn Marriott Bonvoy® points on every stay. Whatever brings you to the city, enjoy a stay beyond the ordinary at AC Hotel Atlanta Downtown.

ATLDT.name: Residence Inn by Marriott Atlanta Downtown
ATLDT.description: The Residence Inn Atlanta-Downtown is a historic boutique property formerly known as the Rhoades - Haverty building, originally built in 1928. It's listed on the National Registry for Historic Places and exudes the charm of a bygone era. Enjoy spacious suites with complimentary breakfast, wireless internet access along with 24-hr access to our onsite exercise facility with prominent views of the world-famous Peachtree Street, a fully-equipped business center, ATM and coin-operated guest laundry facilities. Every suite includes a living area and full kitchens with refrigerator, microwave, stove top, coffee maker, toaster and dishwasher. We’re located across from the Peachtree Center MARTA station, for easy access into Atlanta’s airport. We’re a short walk to the Mercedes Benz Stadium, State Farm Arena, Centennial Olympic Park, World of Coca Cola, Georgia State University, Georgia Aquarium, The Tabernacle, King Center and Rialto Theatre. COSM Atlanta is nearby.

ATLDX.name: Moxy Atlanta Downtown
ATLDX.description: Why be basic when you can stay bold? Step into Moxy Atlanta Downtown, the city’s newest boutique hotel that flips the script on your typical stay. In the heart of downtown, we're within walking distance of Centennial Olympic Park, Georgia Aquarium, State Farm Arena, and the World of Coca-Cola. Check in at Bar Moxy, where your key comes with a cocktail, then hang out in our bright, open lobby designed for connection. Our 24/7 Food & Beverage station keeps you fueled day or night. Craving more? Grab a crave-worthy breakfast sandwich at Eggslut, or take it sky-high at Jagger Suite, our rooftop bar and nightclub-inspired lounge with skyline views, cocktails, and beats that don't quit. When it’s time to recharge, rooms offer plush bedding, 42-inch flat-screen TVs with streaming, USB ports, and fast WiFi. Start your day with a healthy continental breakfast, wind down with wine or a local craft brew, and dive into downtown Atlanta like a local. Whatever brings you to Atlanta, it’s all happening #attheMoxy.

AUSBR.name: Renaissance Austin Downtown Hotel
AUSBR.description: Welcome to Renaissance Austin Downtown, located in downtown Austin just steps from the University of Texas and the State Capitol! With 367 bold, inviting rooms and suites, guests enjoy skyline views and a stay that reflects the city’s vibrant, casually chic spirit. From standout style to signature hospitality, we’re your urban oasis—within walking distance of 6th Street nightlife, the UT campus and stadium, the Moody Center, Zilker Park, and iconic venues like Mohawk, Waterloo, and Stubb’s. Don’t miss Swim Club—our historic pool turned retro-inspired restaurant, bar, and lounge. Colorful and full of flavor, it sits beside our perfectly pink pool and the lush Lawn. It’s the ideal spot to sip, socialize, and soak up the Austin vibe. Planning an event? We offer 40,000+ sq ft of indoor and outdoor space, including the Capitol Ballroom for up to 900 guests, plus flexible breakout rooms and open-air venues. We look forward to welcoming you to Renaissance Austin Downtown.

AUSCM.name: citizenM Austin Downtown
AUSCM.description: citizenM Austin Downtown is deep in the heart of Texas' capital city. From here, take a stroll to the shores of Lady Bird Lake or wander along Congress Avenue. Austin City Limits Live is just a few blocks away – perfect for a night of live music before heading back for a margarita by the rooftop pool. With 344 rooms featuring XL king-size beds, blackout blinds, mood lighting and smart tech, you’ll rest easy – or party hard. Stay connected with free Wi-Fi, fuel up with 24/7 food and drinks at canteenM, and check in like a pro (aka contactless). There’s world-class art, a stylish living room to lounge in, and a fitness room when you need a stretch. All this, just minutes from Downtown Station, Shoal Beach and the Capitol Building. Oh, and we heard everything’s bigger in Texas – including citizenM.

AUSDS.name: Austin Proper Hotel, a Member of Design Hotels™
AUSDS.description: Situated in Downtown's Second Street District, Austin Proper Hotel & Residences offers an artful immersion in lifestyle and well-being.  With emphasis on collaboration, the passionate and compelling vision of designer Kelly Wearstler meets the culinary creativity of Austin tastemaker McGuire Moorman Hospitality.  Essentials include 244 rooms and suites, four unique settings for dining and drink, a focus on wellness with a 2000 square foot fitness center; plus a variety of atmospheric spaces for events.

BOSCH.name: Marriott Vacation Club at Custom House, Boston
BOSCH.description: Marriott Vacation Club Pulse at Custom House, Boston welcomes guests to the original customs building that first welcomed new Americans to the United States. Located in the heart of Boston, our family-friendly vacation rental property offers one-bedroom suites near popular landmarks like the waterfront, Quincy Market, Prudential Center, the Boston Opera House, and the historic Freedom Trail. After a day exploring Boston, return to a spacious vacation rental with separate living and sleeping areas, plus a kitchenette. Many of our suites offer stunning views of Boston Harbor or the downtown Boston skyline. Dine any time with local restaurant delivery, recharge with a visit to our fitness center, or admire the view from the open-air observation deck on our 26th floor. Enjoy family-friendly amenities like our property's on-site movie theater and game room. However you choose to spend your time in Boston, we look forward to welcoming you to our comfortable vacation rentals.

AUSDK.name: Hotel Trinity, Autograph Collection
AUSDK.description: Opening in late 2026, Hotel Trinity will be the only Marriott Autograph Collection hotel in downtown Austin, offering a distinct blend of luxury, privacy, and personality in the heart of the city. This 258-room boutique hotel, including 20 residentially inspired luxury suites, is designed as Austin’s ultimate private hideaway. Guest rooms are among the largest in the market and feature elevated finishes like wood flooring, custom millwork, and locally inspired artwork, creating a refined, home-like experience. Enjoy a world-class dining experience at the exquisite seafood restaurant and oyster bar on the first floor, with valet parking and VIP priority reservations. Or soak up the sun in style at the exclusive rooftop hideaway reserved for hotel guests. With 6,600 square feet of elegant event space, Hotel Trinity offers a refined setting for gatherings from 10 to 200 guests, supported by a team delivering flawless service. Hotel Trinity is where to work, play, and stay out of the fray.

MEMDM.name: Memphis Riverline Hotel
MEMDM.description: Welcome to the Memphis Riverline Hotel, located in the downtown Memphis. The hotel features 500 spaciously appointed guest rooms and suites, designed to provide all the amenities and relaxation for both business and leisure travelers. Enjoy amazing river views and downtown views of the surrounding city, all complemented by modern amenities such as high-speed Wi-Fi, flat screen TV's and plush bedding.  Indulge in on-site dining featuring southern local cuisine. Our restaurant, Crossroads Grille, offers a unique dining experience complete with a full selection of local beers and specialty cocktails and wine. Equipped with over 14,000 sq. ft. of versatile meeting and event space, ready for conferences, weddings and special  events. Our dedicated events team is onsite to ensure that every detail is executed flawlessly allowing you to focus on what matters most.

MTHMC.name: Courtyard Faro Blanco Resort
MTHMC.description: Enjoy a tranquil waterfront getaway at the Courtyard Faro Blanco Resort in the Florida Keys. Courtyard Faro Blanco is a full service resort located in Marathon, Florida, with two onsite resort pools, live music, nightly beach bonfires, lawn games, and unique resort experiences. Participate in our family friendly Caribbean style event with live music, Eventide, every evening a half hour before sunset. Two onsite restaurants offer daily breakfast, lunch, dinner and a full service bar so you never have to go far to quench your cravings. Explore the warm waters of the Florida Keys with a variety of watersports available from our private dock. Take a thrilling ride on a private jet ski rental or a leisurely paddle on a clear kayak. Complimentary bikes and beach accessories such as chairs, coolers, and umbrellas are available for your use as you explore the Florida Keys. Courtyard Faro Blanco boasts more than 14,000 sq ft of flexible indoor and outdoor space to fit all types of events, weddings and meetings.

NYCVC.name: Marriott Vacation Club, New York City
NYCVC.description: Experience everything Manhattan offers from the sophisticated lodgings available at Marriott Vacation Club Pulse New York City. Situated in the heart of Midtown NYC in the Fashion District our family friendly vacation ownership property offers all you need for an incredible visit. Outside our trendy vacation spot find yourself near New York City subway lines, Penn Station and Grand Central Station. Get easy access to every corner of the city with Madison Square Garden, Times Square, Bryant Park, Central Park and the shops of Madison Avenue nearby. Enjoy evening cocktails at our popular rooftop bar Top of the Strand, overlooking the Empire State Building. Our guest room accommodations feature mahogany furniture, plush bedding and inspiring views of the NYC skyline. No matter if you stay a week or weekend we look forward to welcoming you to our vacation property in New York. Marriott Vacation Club Pulse, New York City is marketed by Juris Properties NY, LLC, 33 West 37th Street, New York, New York 10018.

SANBD.name: Alma San Diego Downtown, a Tribute Portfolio Hotel
SANBD.description: At the intersection of work and play, Alma San Diego offers the perfect balance for the immersive traveler. Our stylish, vibrant hotel located in the heart of downtown San Diego is nestled between the historic Gaslamp Quarter & Little Italy.  Alma blends Mexican heritage with a laid-back Southern California style. Every detail of rooms and suites tell you the story with feature rich wood floors, Art Deco furniture and upscale amenities to ensure a relaxing stay. Soak up the sun in our rooftop pool, explore on one of our bikes and grab a bite plus a drink at The Café. Savor unique flavors at our signature restaurant, The Desmond. We love furry friends too, so our pet-friendly San Diego hotel welcomes your pup. There’s always something to do at Alma, but when you want to explore wider San Diego, you’ll find we’re close to many attractions like the Bay, Balboa Park, San Diego Zoo, Sea World and much more. Alma offers 20,000 sq ft of beautiful event space with delicious catering for the perfectly refined event.

SANVA.name: Marriott Vacation Club, San Diego
SANVA.description: An unforgettable experience awaits you at Marriott Vacation Club Pulse, San Diego, a vacation ownership property that puts you in the heart of downtown San Diego. Blending historic ambiance and downtown energy, we welcome you to San Diego with stylish suite vacation rentals and superb amenities. Book our accommodations in downtown San Diego to be near the bustling Gaslamp Quarter, scenic Balboa Park and other famous attractions. Families love our modern lodging and convenient location only minutes from kid-friendly destinations like SeaWorld and the San Diego Zoo. Fuel your getaway at SHAKE, our signature restaurant and bar, or stay fit in our modern, 24-hour fitness center. Experience a relaxing retreat in our well-appointed vacation rental suites which provide separate living areas, well-equipped kitchenettes, complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi and flat-screen LCD TVs.

SAVAC.name: AC Hotel Savannah Historic District
SAVAC.description: Overlooking the Savannah River, AC Hotel Savannah Historic District offers a chic, modern retreat in the heart of Savannah’s history and traditional beauty. Our hotel is just a short walk from all that the historic district has to offer or hop on a trolley right outside our doors to see the sights. Take a stroll down River Street for fantastic dining and shopping or take in Savannah’s beauty from the water on a Savannah Riverboat cruise. After you are welcomed with southern hospitality, relax in our carefully designed lobby or visit our rooftop restaurant & bar with sprawling views of the river, indoor/outdoor seating, and delicious curated cocktails. Take advantage of our free Wi-fi to focus in your guestroom or relax and take in the views from one of our many riverfront rooms with balconies.  Business travelers can book a Media Salon for a small, impromptu meeting or the Wilmington Ballroom for a larger gathering of up to 210 attendees.

SEAZP.name: citizenM Seattle Pioneer Square
SEAZP.description: In downtown Seattle’s historic Pioneer Square, citizenM puts you right among leafy streets, indie galleries, and coffee spots galore – all in the shadow of the legendary Smith Tower. Wake up in the fluffiest pillows known to humankind (on an XL bed, naturally), then hit the waterfront, stadiums or aquarium – all a short stroll away. The rooms are designed for smart stays: blackout blinds, mood lighting, Chromecast and app-controlled everything. Downstairs, there's canteenM serving food and drinks 24/7, a stylish living room made for laptops or lounging, and societyM meeting rooms for big ideas. With King Street Station just 9 minutes away and Pioneer Square light rail even closer, getting around is a breeze. And when you're ready to retreat, you’ve got art on the walls, a cocktail in hand and Seattle at your feet.

TPADS.name: SpringHill Suites Tampa Downtown
TPADS.description: Travel in style at SpringHill Suites by Marriott®, the all-suite hotel that seamlessly blends design and functionality offering the modern amenities you need to stay refreshed and focused - all at an affordable price. Spacious suites and vibrant lobbies offer flexible spaces perfect for working, meeting or relaxing. Take the stress out of travel with free Wi-Fi, relaxing pools and fitness centers. Our Market is open 24/7 for snacks and necessities. Enjoy our complimentary new breakfast with fresh choices for a customized start to your day - like eggs with local salsa or Greek yogurt and oatmeal complete with a toppings bar for a variety of options. Quite simply, from business trips to leisurely journeys, SpringHill Suites is a breath of fresh air.

TPAWH.name: Westin Tampa Downtown Waterside
TPAWH.description: Edging the shimmering waterfront near celebrated downtown attractions, The Westin Tampa Waterside is a haven of wellness and renewal. Embrace relaxation in newly renovated hotel accommodations with residential-inspired floorplans, modern essentials, plush furnishings and signature amenities. Delight your palate with fresh seafood and handcrafted cocktails at our scenic Blue Harbour Eatery + Bar. Stay in a coveted location within steps of the Tampa Convention Center near the Florida Aquarium, Sparkman Wharf, Amalie Arena, Tampa Riverwalk and Raymond James Stadium at our Tampa waterside hotel. Create and innovate in inspiring event spaces, designed for meetings, weddings and social engagements. Punctuate a day of business, shopping or sightseeing with a refreshing swim in our sparkling outdoor pool and an invigorating workout in our signature fitness studio in our hotel in Tampa, FL. Designed to replenish the body and mind, The Westin Tampa Waterside is a scenic sanctuary amid a vibrant travel destination.

WASMM.name: : Le Méridien Washington, D.C., The Madison
WASMM.description: Nestled in the heart of the city, Le Méridien Madison, Washington, DC offers a harmonious blend of timeless elegance and contemporary flair. Drawing inspiration from its namesake, the hotel embodies the sophistication of a Parisian retreat while reflecting the vibrant energy of our nation’s capital. The hotel’s boutique charm is highlighted by a welcoming lobby that captures the essence of both classic refinement and modern vibrancy.Our newly renovated guestrooms and select suites provide a sanctuary from the city’s hustle and bustle, ideal for business, leisure, or both. For those seeking an elevated experience, our luxurious penthouse suites feature expansive terraces with breathtaking views of the Capitol skyline. Personalized amenities—including pet-friendly accommodations—ensure that every guest, even the furry ones, enjoys the utmost comfort and care. Centrally located in downtown Washington, D.C., guests are within walking distance of historic landmarks like The White House.

WASMV.name: Marriott Vacation Club at The Mayflower, Washington, D.C.
WASMV.description: Marriott Vacation Club Pulse at The Mayflower Washington DC sets the stage for remarkable stays with an urban flair.  Nestled on the seventh floor of The Mayflower Hotel, Autograph Collection our vacation ownership property features well-appointed guest rooms and suites that offer guests a blend of modern style and historic elegance in the heart of the downtown district, steps away from Dupont Circle and other nearby attractions.  Gorgeously designed rooms and suites feature plush bedding, high-end bath products, high-speed wireless internet and flat screen TVs.  Guests may take advantage of convenient access to amenities and restaurants such as The Mayflower Hotel’s lively American brasserie, Edgar Bar and Kitchen.  Immerse yourself in the rich history and modern refinement that the property offers while exploring the local attractions, cultural arts venues, famous shopping, dining and more.
